q.q: In C, what does the % (modulo) operator return?
q.x: The modulo operator % returns the remainder, e.g. 10 % 3 = 1.

q.q: Which C data type is used to store whole numbers?
q.x: int stores integers. float and double store real numbers, and char stores a single character.

q.q: What is the value of sizeof(char) in standard C?
q.x: In standard C, sizeof(char) is defined to be exactly 1 byte.
